title: Add a reproducible document discovery mode
summary: Combine a scoped document graph with reviewed semantic links and concrete source anchors when a project has relevant materials.
acceptance_criteria: Show exact source SHA and anchors for each relationship.
Rebuild from a retained reviewed extraction without a model API call on the hosted verifier.
Keep extraction method and unknown usage visible in the receipt.

evidence.claim: The launcher template keeps a pinned semantic extraction with per-file source hashes.
